name: fr-bench
description: fr-bench is a benchmark published on Hugging Face by Alignment-Lab-AI intended to evaluate model behavior in French. It collects prompts and reference responses across tasks (classification, generation, and safety/alignment checks) to measure correctness and adherence to safety/alignment guidelines in French outputs. The suite is useful for assessing French-language instruction following and refusal behavior.
reputation: A specialized dataset used mainly by alignment and French-language model evaluators; modest community visibility.
